entities.summary: In business and engineering, new product development (NPD) or simply product development is the complete process of bringing a new product to market. Product development also includes the renewal of an existing product and the introduction of an existing product into a new market. New product development is the realization of a market opportunity by making a product available for purchase. The products developed by a commercial organization provide the means to generate income. A central aspect of NPD is product design.
